name: chain_verify
reasoning: All logical chains are internally consistent. The statements form a coherent diagnostic chain: clinical findings establish acute compartment syndrome, then multiple supporting data points (urate crystals, tophi, gout history, lack of infection/vascular injury, mild CK) logically support acute gout flare with tophaceous tenosynovitis as the underlying cause. Alternative diagnoses are appropriately considered and then weakened by the evidence. No broken causal or logical links are present.
